title: Brief
description: A pm-dispatch dispatch brief — work definition consumed by codex / claude executor. Mirrors docs/dispatch-brief.md schema. Distinct from Handover: Brief = work definition, Handover = dispatch envelope.

files.description: Sandbox allowlist (per docs/dispatch-brief.md §files: block semantics). A `read:` entry means the executor MAY open that file, NOT that it must pre-load it. For survey-style briefs, add a `context:` instruction telling the executor to read on demand.

self_verify.description: Required for file-writing briefs (any entry tagged write:/new: or untagged). Read-only briefs (every files: entry tagged read:) may omit. Conditional requirement enforced by pmctl validate (M2).

qa_checklist.description: Required when brief introduces >= 3 behavioral units. See agents/project-pm.md `qa_checklist` rule.

expected_head_sha.description: Recommended for briefs touching > 4 files. Catches branch-drift before patch is attempted.

context.description: Free-form background; survey-style briefs put lazy-read instructions here.

task.description: Free-form per-run task instructions used by composed workflows (pr-gate etc.).

output_format.description: When the deliverable is a report, specifies file path + required sections.
